feature: Native sow-rule XML abstract templates for selected Foraging species
scope: Stage abstract RimWorld ThingDef inheritance templates for adopted researched native tree planting (Kuri, walnut, Kaya), ordinary Ground sowing (Fuki, Udo), and non-sowable wild plants/fungi, while leaving Environment Shii unchanged. No concrete food item Defs, numeric plant behavior, harvest loops, art or playable Mod.

queries: RimWorld Vanilla PlantBase TreeBase sowTags sowResearchPrerequisites mustBeWildToSow XML
Vanilla Plants Expanded More Plants trees sowTags
VV New Harvest Trees planted trees Vivi tree gathering
AMJ Environment native Shii regional tree sowing contract
search.limitations: Core XML mirror on master not a certified installed 1.6 version; concrete playable Defs would require actual graphics, products, work/yield/season, conditional biome distribution, 1.6 runtime and user-approved food tuning. This narrow decision authorizes ONLY abstract native XML inheritance and static guards; no loaded game claim. VV full source not obtained; not a blocker for using vanilla sowing fields.

candidates.name: Vanilla core PlantBase/TreeBase and researched tree sowing
candidates.version: Core XML master verified 2026-10-14, loaded 1.6 unverified

comparison.function: TreeBase inherits Ground, TreeSowing and mustBeWildToSow; PlantBase is unsowable absent added sowTags; Vanilla farm plants use Ground.
comparison.historical_fit: Native vanilla planting accurately models wild woody planting and fuki/udo horticulture without new mechanic.
comparison.dependencies: Only RimWorld Core; MO 1.6 tree subclasses also inherit TreeBase.
comparison.retention: Keep existing sow/growing zone, research and wood-harvest untouched.
comparison.progression_balance: No work, yield or growth values fixed; requirements unchanged.
comparison.maintenance_license: Do not copy XML sources; write Foraging-owned small abstract inheritance bases.

candidates.name: AMJ Environment existing regional Shii tree sowing

comparison.function: Native Region TreeSowing inherited by Environment Shii, its Def remains Environment-owned.
comparison.historical_fit: Existing Sudajii appearance and research gate accepted.
comparison.dependencies: Required Environment, one-way Foraging to Environment.
comparison.retention: Preserve Shii PlantDef and original tree research list/wood.
comparison.progression_balance: Regional sow gate reused; no additional research or green balancing.
comparison.reuse: No Shii XML override at all.
comparison.maintenance_license: AMJE authorship remains original; base owner controls future changes.

comparison.function: Fruit-primary tree definitions under native plant Base classes; crop harvest differs from wood-primary Shii nut gather.
comparison.historical_fit: Orchards are not baseline Japanese food planting but reuse ordinary native growing zone.
comparison.dependencies: VE not needed for native sow field inheritance.
comparison.retention: Could add excessive crops/frameworks absent author choice.
comparison.progression_balance: Season/nutrient definitions excluded from this scope.
comparison.reuse: No VPE code or Def needed, only native XML field names.
comparison.maintenance_license: No VPE art or code reproduction, no VE dependency.

candidates.name: VV New Harvest Trees and Vivi independent gather

comparison.function: Fruit/tree content and separate wood-preserving gather precedent, not a replacement for researched native tree sowing.
comparison.historical_fit: Japanese forest collection theme is separate from generic orchard or race gathering systems.
comparison.dependencies: VV/Vivi dependencies not acceptable for basic sow fields.
comparison.retention: No replacement of Foraging's accepted species or Environment's scenery.
comparison.progression_balance: No new breeding/farming system or yield balance is needed.
comparison.reuse: Use as prior art for collection only; use Vanilla for planting.
comparison.maintenance_license: No third-party code/images copied; VV actual complete 1.6 XML unavailable.

decision.rationale: Author approves individual plantability; native TreeBase already implements researched regional forest tree planting without C# and PlantBase plus sowTags Ground implements grow-zone planting. There is no need to import VE, VV or Vivi for baseline sow flags. Abstract source templates can encode the approved plantability safely without inventing yields/biomes/assets and without mutating Environment Shii. Actual species and functional plant Defs require a separate content approval and loaded tests.
